searchText: <kevaundray> re: **@chfast** > I'm not sure what's your status on not using big.Int in modexp gas calculation. But I've ported evmone's code which uses uint32`/`uint64 to Erigon. A quick check locally shows 0–14% mgps improvement. Kamil had the exact numbers on how much it improved geth -- 0-14% sounds like a reasonable speedup where the higher numbers are likely on smaller modexp operations, since the ratio of gas calculation to modexp calculation would be smaller <KamilChNethermind> What do EL and CL client team devs think about some sort of Log Info/Warns about gaslimit "under configured"? We are just behind the corner to hit 45 but it required quite huge effort from Pari (thanks for that!) - and still seems like a lot of homestakers and others are even at 30M. We could align at the message and keep on repeating it every few minutes to make it visible but not too annoying - could give us few more k of validators moving without need to ask too much. <KamilChNethermind> BTW just now first block with 40MGas landed :) <parithoshj> ^ not all CLs have made their 45M update release yet. So part of the data could just be that <KamilChNethermind> re: **@parithoshj** > ^ not all CLs have made their 45M update release yet. So part of the data could just be that That is also something we should all coordinate a bit better if there is common agreement on gas limit bump - to make effort smaller moving forward (especially that we are not that far from thinking about next bump in next months) <ben_a_adams> re: **@KamilChNethermind** > @ben_a_adams did Damian made already any experient with it? Alas the trie isn't MPT; so not directly a drop in for L1 <fede_intern> re: **@KamilChNethermind** > @ben_a_adams did Damian made already any experient with it? we did it in ethrex <fede_intern> https://github.com/lambdaclass/ethrex/pull/1716 <fede_intern> you can use it in L2 but L1 as Ben said it's not compatbile. we are working on something similar that uses MPT <FunnyGiulio> Afaik qmdb's trick is that the sort order is insertion timestamp and not hashed keys. So idk how you can even optimize around it <fede_intern> re: **@FunnyGiulio** > Afaik qmdb's trick is that the sort order is insertion timestamp and not hashed keys. So idk how you can even optimize around it the biggest improvement they have is that they don't store a tree on top of another tree <FunnyGiulio> re: **@fede_intern** > the biggest improvement they have is that they don't store a tree on top of another tree Uh alright. I thought that the data locality would play a bigger factor <notnotstorm_p> re: **@fede_intern** > you can use it in L2 but L1 as Ben said it's not compatbile. we are working on something similar that uses MPT what is possible for the MPT?

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<kevaundray> re: **@chfast**
> I'm not sure what's your status on not using big.Int in modexp gas calculation. But I've ported evmone's code which uses uint32`/`uint64 to Erigon. A quick check locally shows 0–14% mgps improvement.
Kamil had the exact numbers on how much it improved geth -- 0-14% sounds like a reasonable speedup where the higher numbers are likely on smaller modexp operations, since the ratio of gas calculation to modexp calculation would be smaller

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<KamilChNethermind> What do EL and CL client team devs think about some sort of Log Info/Warns about gaslimit "under configured"? 

We are just behind the corner to hit 45 but it required quite huge effort from Pari (thanks for that!) - and still seems like a lot of homestakers and others are even at 30M.

We could align at the message and keep on repeating it every few minutes to make it visible but not too annoying - could give us few more k of validators moving without need to ask too much.
